name: Hiroaki Uzuki
source:
Though "Ultimate Apprentice" is certainly an unusual title, it perfectly describes the way Hiroaki transcends traditional expertise. Under the tutelage of various accomplished mentors, he has mastered hundreds of talents: baking, catering, woodworking, and many, many more.

Hiroaki believes that the only way to challenge himself intellectually is by constantly shifting disciplines. Hiroaki's employers have consistently supported his passion for broadening his skills, though the departure of their most gifted employee often leaves them overcome with emotion and grappling with economic hardship; they often need to hire five new workers to replace him.

It has been Hiroaki's lifelong aspiration to attend Bitokukawa Academy, and now, through his unshakeable work ethic and academic dedication, he has achieved it. Greatness is in store for this honest, humble, and above all, talented young man.

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/danganronpa/comments/1e7dap9/meet_hiroaki_the_ultimate_apprentice/]bio[/url]]
